t: The Drone Interface is a $(thing)ComputerCraft/OpenComputers peripheral/$ that's used to communicate with $(l:tools/drone)Drones/$. To do so, program a $(item)Drone/$ with a $(l:programming/computer_control)Computer Control puzzle piece/$.$(p)When the Drone executes the Computer Control piece, it'll try to connect to an $(ttcolor)$(t:A Drone Interface can only connect to one Drone at a time)available/$ $(item)Drone Interface/$ located within the puzzle piece's area.

无人机接口是一种$(thing)ComputerCraft/OpenComputers 外设/$，用于与$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$通信。为此，需要给$(item)雄蜂/$编入一个$(l:programming/computer_control)计算机控制拼图块/$。$(p)当雄蜂执行这个计算机控制拼图块时，它会尝试连接到位于该拼图块作用范围内、$(ttcolor)$(t:A Drone Interface can only connect to one Drone at a time)可用/$的$(item)无人机接口/$。

Once connected, the Drone will be controlled entirely by the interface; specifically, by Lua methods called on the interface by the controlling computer.$(p)The Drone Interface exposes a long list of Lua methods, all of which are described in the following pages.
连接后，雄蜂将完全由该接口控制；更具体地说，是由控制计算机在该接口上调用的 Lua 方法来控制。$(p)无人机接口提供了大量 Lua 方法，后续页面将对其进行详细说明。

An example Lua program:$(br)$(#008)m = peripheral.wrap("right")$(br)m.addArea(100, 64, 100, 120, 4, 120, "Filled")$(br)m.setAction("dig")$(br)while not m.isActionDone()$(br)do$(br)  sleep(1)$(br)end$(br)m.clearArea()$(br)m.addArea(80, 65, 80)$(br)m.setAction("goto")$(br)-- wait till done, as above$(br)m.setAction("standby")$(p)/$makes the drone dig out a large area - all blocks in the (100,64,100)->(120,4,120) range - and then return to (80, 65, 80) and go into standby.

一个 Lua 程序示例：$(br)$(#008)m = peripheral.wrap("right")$(br)m.addArea(100, 64, 100, 120, 4, 120, "Filled")$(br)m.setAction("dig")$(br)while not m.isActionDone()$(br)do$(br)  sleep(1)$(br)end$(br)m.clearArea()$(br)m.addArea(80, 65, 80)$(br)m.setAction("goto")$(br)-- 等待执行完成（方式同上）$(br)m.setAction("standby")$(p)/$该程序使无人机挖掘一大片区域——即坐标范围 (100,64,100) 至 (120,4,120) 内的所有方块——然后返回至坐标 (80, 65, 80) 并进入待机状态。

You may notice that the program opposite has to explicitly wait until the Dig (and Goto) actions are done before continuing, unlike when writing Drone programs via the $(l:programming/programmer)Programmer/$. This is because your Lua computer program is running in a separate thread and can't interact with the world directly; it just tells the drone what to do next, and needs to ask the drone if it's done yet.
你可能会注意到，对面的这个程序必须明确等待 Dig（挖掘）和 Goto（前往）动作完成后才能继续；而通过$(l:programming/programmer)编程器/$编写无人机程序时则不是这样。这是因为你的 Lua 电脑程序运行在独立线程中，无法直接与世界交互；它只能告诉无人机下一步该做什么，并且需要询问无人机是否已经完成。

$(#800)addArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>)/$$(p)$(#800)addArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>,<x2>,<y2>,<z2>,<areaType>)/$$(p)Adds an area to the current stored area of the Drone. When using the latter method, x1/y1/z1 represent the first point (which would be P1 of an $(l:tools/gps_area_tool)GPS Area Tool/$), and x2/y2/z2 represent the second point, or P2 of the GPS Area Tool.$(p)getAreaTypes() can be used to list the valid area types.

$(#800)addArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>)/$$(p)$(#800)addArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>,<x2>,<y2>,<z2>,<areaType>)/$$(p)将一个区域添加到无人机当前存储的区域中。使用后一种方法时，x1/y1/z1 表示第一个点（也就是$(l:tools/gps_area_tool)区域定位工具/$的 P1），而 x2/y2/z2 表示第二个点，也就是区域定位工具的 P2。$(p)可使用 getAreaTypes() 列出有效的区域类型。
$(#800)addBlacklistItemFilter(<item/block name>, <useNBT>, <useModSimilarity>)/$$(p)Like the addWhitelistItemFilter(...), but to blacklist items.
$(#800)addBlacklistItemFilter(<item/block name>, <useNBT>, <useModSimilarity>)/$$(p)与 addWhitelistItemFilter(...) 类似，但用于将物品加入黑名单。
$(#800)addBlacklistLiquidFilter(<liquid name>)/$$(p)Like the addWhitelistLiquidFilter(...), but to blacklist liquids.
$(#800)addBlacklistLiquidFilter(<液体名称>)/$$(p)与 addWhitelistLiquidFilter(...) 类似，但用于将液体加入黑名单。
$(#800)addBlacklistText(<text>)/$$(p)Adds a text to the blacklisted texts. Used to specify a filter for the "entity_attack" action, for example.
$(#800)addBlacklistText(<text>)/$$(p)向黑名单文本中添加一段文本。例如，可用于为“entity_attack”动作指定过滤条件。

$(#800)addWhitelistItemFilter(<item/block name>, <useNBT>, <useModSimilarity>)/$$(p)Acts as an $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widget on the right of another widget. The item/block name is the registry name, e.g. $(thing)pneumaticcraft:pressure_tube/$. The 'useXXX' are all booleans that determine what filters will be used (as in the Item Filter widget GUI).

$(#800)addWhitelistItemFilter(<物品/方块名称>, <useNBT>, <useModSimilarity>)/$$(p)作为另一个组件右侧的一个$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$组件。物品/方块名称为注册名，例如$(thing)pneumaticcraft:pressure_tube/$。其中“useXXX”全都是布尔值，用于决定启用哪些过滤条件（与物品过滤器组件 GUI 中的设置相同）。

$(#800)addWhitelistLiquidFilter(<liquid name>)/$$(p)Acts as you've put a $l(:programming/liquid_filter)Liquid Filter/$ piece on the right of a piece. You must supply the fluid's registry name (e.g. $(thing)minecraft:water/$).
$(#800)addWhitelistLiquidFilter(<液体名称>)/$$(p)效果等同于在一个部件的右侧放置了一个 $l(:programming/liquid_filter)液体过滤器/$部件。你必须提供该流体的注册名（例如$(thing)minecraft:water/$）。
$(#800)addWhitelistText(<text>)/$$(p)Adds a text to the whitelisted text list. This would be used to specify an entity filter for the "entity_attack" action, for example.
$(#800)addWhitelistText(<text>)/$$(p)向白名单文本列表中添加一段文本。例如，这可用于为 "entity_attack" 动作指定实体过滤器。
$(#800)clearBlacklistItemFilter()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的黑名单物品过滤器。
$(#800)clearBlacklistLiquidFilter()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的黑名单液体过滤器。
$(#800)clearBlacklistText()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的黑名单文本。
$(#800)clearWhitelistItemFilter()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的白名单物品过滤器。
$(#800)clearWhitelistLiquidFilter()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的白名单液体过滤器。
$(#800)clearWhitelistText()/$$(p)清除所有已存储的白名单文本。

$(#800)evaluateCondition()/$$(p)Returns true/false. Used in $(l:programming/conditions)conditions/$ only. Will return true/false depending on whether or not the condition is satisfied. Drone Conditions can be checked right after setting $(#800)setAction()/$, but non-Drone conditions require that you wait until $(#800)isActionDone()/$ returns true before the result of $(#800)evaluateCondition()/$ is useful.

$(#800)evaluateCondition()/$$(p)返回 true/false。仅用于$(l:programming/conditions)conditions/$。它会根据条件是否满足来返回 true/false。无人机条件可以在设置$(#800)setAction()/$后立即检查，但对于非无人机条件，你需要等到$(#800)isActionDone()/$返回 true 后，$(#800)evaluateCondition()/$的结果才有意义。
$(#800)exitPiece()/$$(p)Stops the $(thing)Computer Control/$ piece in the Drone, and allows the Drone's program to proceed to the next puzzle piece in its program.
$(#800)exitPiece()/$$(p)停止无人机中的$(thing)计算机控制/$拼图块，并让无人机程序继续执行程序中的下一个拼图块。
$(#800)forgetTarget()/$$(p)When the Drone is targeting any entity (from using the "entity_attack" action), this will stop attacking that target.
$(#800)forgetTarget()/$$(p)当雄蜂正在以任意实体为目标（通过使用“entity_attack”动作）时，这将停止攻击该目标。

$(#800)getAction()/$$(p)Returns a string that represents the last action set by $(#800)setAction()/$. Will return $(thing)nil/$ when no action is set. Can be used to make sure to only call $(#800)isActionDone()/$ when this method does not return nil.
$(#800)getAction()/$$(p)返回一个字符串，表示由$(#800)setAction()/$设置的上一个动作。未设置任何动作时将返回$(thing)nil/$。可用于确保仅在此方法不返回 nil 时才调用$(#800)isActionDone()/$。

$(#800)getAllActions()/$$(p)Returns a table of all the current selectable actions (like $(thing)pneumaticcraft:dig/$ or $(thing)pneumaticcraft:place'/$. Each of these actions corresponds directly to a programming widget available in the $(l:programming/programmer#ids)Programmer/$ GUI.$(p)Note: for actions which start with $(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$ (which is all default actions), the $(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$ prefix is optional.

$(#800)getAllActions()/$$(p)返回一个包含当前所有可选择动作的表（例如$(thing)pneumaticcraft:dig/$或$(thing)pneumaticcraft:place'/$）。这些动作中的每一个都直接对应于$(l:programming/programmer#ids)编程器/$ GUI 中可用的一个编程元件。$(p)注意：对于以$(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$开头的动作（即所有默认动作），前缀$(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$是可选的。
$(#800)getAreaTypes()/$$(p)Returns a table of all the possible area types (filled, frame, sphere...)
$(#800)getAreaTypes()/$$(p)返回所有可能区域类型的表（填充、框架、球体……）

$(#800)getDronePosition()/$$(p)Returns the x/y/z position of the Drone. This method is here for historic compatibility, and it's recommended to use the new $(#800)getDronePositionVec()/$ method instead.
$(#800)getDronePosition()/$$(p)返回无人机的 x/y/z 坐标。此方法保留是为了兼容旧版本，建议改用新的$(#800)getDronePositionVec()/$方法。

$(#800)getDronePosition()/$$(p)Returns a table of the x/y/z coordinates of the Drone. Individual values can be easily extracted with the .x, .y and .z fields, e.g. $(#800)xpos = getDronePosition().x/$.
$(#800)getDronePosition()/$$(p)返回一个包含无人机 x/y/z 坐标的表。可通过 .x、.y 和 .z 字段轻松提取各个值，例如$(#800)xpos = getDronePosition().x/$。

$(#800)getUpgrades(<upgrade>)/$$(p)Get the number of inserted upgrades of the given type.$(p)The upgrade name can be found by mousing over any PneumaticCraft upgrade item with advanced info enabled (F3+H) and taking the item name with the '_upgrade' part removed.$(p)e.g for $(thing)pneumaticcraft:speed_upgrade/$, the name is "speed".
$(#800)getUpgrades(<upgrade>)/$$(p)获取已插入的指定类型升级数量。$(p)升级名称可以通过在启用高级信息（F3+H）时，将鼠标悬停在任意气动工艺升级物品上查看；取其物品名称并移除“_upgrade”部分即可。$(p)例如，对于$(thing)pneumaticcraft:speed_upgrade/$，其名称是“speed”。

$(#800)getVariable(<variable name>)/$$(p)Returns the value of the variable from this Drone (x, y and z). It is possible to get $(l:programming/variables#global)global/$ (# prefix) and $(l:programming/variables#special)special/$ variables ($ prefix) too.
$(#800)getVariable(<变量名>)/$$(p)返回该雄蜂中的变量值（x、y 和 z）。也可以获取$(l:programming/variables#global)全局/$（# 前缀）和$(l:programming/variables#special)特殊/$（$ 前缀）变量。
$(#800)hideArea()/$$(p)Stops in-world highlighting of the area stored in the Drone, as shown by $(#800)showArea()/$.
$(#800)hideArea()/$$(p)停止高亮显示存储在无人机中的区域，该区域可通过$(#800)showArea()/$在世界中显示。
$(#800)isActionDone()/$$(p)Returns true if the current action is done (e.g. "goto" has arrived at the target location, "inventory import" can't import anymore, "dig" has dug every possible block...)
$(#800)isActionDone()/$$(p)如果当前动作已完成，则返回 true（例如，“goto”已到达目标位置，“inventory import”已无法继续导入，“dig”已挖掘所有可能的方块……）
$(#800)isConnectedToDrone()/$$(p)Returns true if a Drone has connected with this Drone Interface (when the Drone's program has arrived at the ComputerCraft piece and made a connection).
$(#800)isConnectedToDrone()/$$(p)如果有一只雄蜂已连接到此无人机接口，则返回 true（即当雄蜂的程序到达 ComputerCraft 部件并建立连接时）。
$(#800)removeArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>,<x2>,<y2>,<z2>,<areaType>)/$$(p)Removes an area from the current stored area (equivalent to blacklisting the area).
$(#800)removeArea(<x1>,<y1>,<z1>,<x2>,<y2>,<z2>,<areaType>)/$$(p)从当前已存储的区域中移除一个区域（等同于将该区域加入黑名单）。

$(#800)setAction(<action>)/$$(p)Set an action for the Drone to do. This should be one of the actions returned by $(#800)getAllActions()/$; these correspond directly to programming widgets in the $(l:programming/programmer)Programmer/$ GUI, which shows the action name in widget tooltips when F3+H is toggled.$(p)Note that when the prefix is $(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$, that prefix is optional.

$(#800)setAction(<action>)/$$(p)为无人机设置一个要执行的动作。这应当是由$(#800)getAllActions()/$返回的动作之一；这些动作与$(l:programming/programmer)Programmer/$ GUI 中的编程组件直接对应，并且在开启 F3+H 时，会在组件提示框中显示动作名称。$(p)请注意，当前缀为$(thing)pneumaticcraft:/$时，该前缀是可选的。
$(#800)setBlockOrder(<"closest"/"highToLow"/"lowToHigh">)/$$(p)Sets the place/dig order of the Drone.
$(#800)setBlockOrder(<"closest"/"highToLow"/"lowToHigh">)/$$(p)设置雄蜂放置/挖掘方块的顺序。

$(#800)setCanSteal(<true/false>)/$$(p)When the "pickup_item" action is used, this controls whether drones are allowed to steal items they normally should leave alone, e.g. items on an $(thing)Immersive Engineering/$ conveyor belt.$(p)The default is 'false': drones will not try to steal items.
$(#800)setCanSteal(<true/false>)/$$(p)使用“pickup_item”动作时，此项用于控制无人机是否可以顺手牵羊拿走它们通常应当不去碰的物品，例如位于$(thing)Immersive Engineering/$传送带上的物品。$(p)默认值为“false”：无人机不会尝试顺手牵羊拿取物品。

$(#800)setCheckLineOfSight(<true/false>)/$$(p)When the "entity_attack" action is used, this controls whether drones will attack any target in their area, or only targets they have a direct line of sight to.$(p)The default is 'false'; line of sight is not checked.
$(#800)setCheckLineOfSight(<true/false>)/$$(p)当使用“entity_attack”动作时，这会控制无人机是攻击其区域内的任意目标，还是只攻击与其有直接视线连接的目标。$(p)默认值为 'false'；不会检查视线。
$(#800)setCount(<amount>)/$$(p)This configures the maximum number of items processed by import / export / drop actions, and is also used for the amount that's checked against in condition checks.
$(#800)setCount(<amount>)/$$(p)这将配置导入/导出/丢弃操作可处理的物品最大数量，也会用于条件检查时的数量判定。

$(#800)setCraftingGrid(<item/block name>, <item/block name>, ...(9x))/$$(p)Sets up the crafting grid so when the "crafting" action is used, this recipe will be used. You need to specify all 9 items making up the recipe; for empty spaces supply $(thing)nil/$. The item naming format is the same as for item filters.
$(#800)setCraftingGrid(<物品/方块名称>, <物品/方块名称>, ...(9x))/$$(p)设置合成终端，这样在使用“crafting”操作时，就会使用这个配方。你需要指定构成该配方的全部 9 个物品；空位请填入$(thing)nil/$。物品命名格式与物品过滤器相同。

$(#800)setDropStraight(<true/false>)/$$(p)When the "drop_item" action is the current action, this determines whether or not the item will be dropped with a random velocity (like a vanilla Dropper), or straight down.
$(#800)setDropStraight(<true/false>)/$$(p)当“drop_item”动作为当前动作时，这将决定物品被丢弃时是带有随机速度（类似原版投掷器），还是直接垂直下落。
$(#800)setEmittingRedstone(<strength>)/$$(p)Sets the strength of redstone signal to emit when the "emit_redstone" action is the current action.
$(#800)setEmittingRedstone(<strength>)/$$(p)当“emit_redstone”动作是当前动作时，设置要输出的红石信号强度。
$(#800)setIsAndFunction(<true/false>)/$$(p)Used in conditions only. When true, all checked blocks must satisfy the condition requirements (>=10 etc).
$(#800)setIsAndFunction(<true/false>)/$$(p)仅用于条件中。设为 true 时，所有被检查的方块都必须满足条件要求（>=10 等）。

$(#800)setMaxActions(<amount>)/$$(p)This sets the maximum number of actions performed on blocks before the action is considered 'done'. This applies to the "place", "dig" and "block_right_click" actions. Be sure to also call $(#800)setUseMaxActions(true)/$ to enable usage of this.
$(#800)setMaxActions(<amount>)/$$(p)这会设置在该操作被视为“完成”之前，对方块执行的最大操作次数。这适用于“place”、“dig”和“block_right_click”操作。请务必同时调用$(#800)setUseMaxActions(true)/$以启用此功能。

$(#800)setOperator(<"=" / ">=" / "<=">)/$$(p)Used in conditions only. Says whether or not the condition is checking for an equal amount (=), an equal or greater than amount (>=), or an equal or lesser than amount (<=). The amount can be set using $(#800)setCount()/$.
$(#800)setOperator(<"=" / ">=" / "<=">)/$$(p)仅用于条件中。用于指定条件检查的是等于（=）、大于等于（>=）还是小于等于（<=）。数量可以通过$(#800)setCount()/$设置。

$(#800)setPlaceFluidBlocks(<true/false>)/$$(p)Only used in the "liquid_export" action; when set to true the Drone will be allowed to place down fluid blocks in the world. Default of 'false' only allows fluids to be exported to fluid tanks.
$(#800)setPlaceFluidBlocks(<true/false>)/$$(p)仅用于“liquid_export”动作；设为 true 时，雄蜂将被允许在世界中放置流体对应方块。默认值“false”只允许将流体导出到流体储罐中。
$(#800)setRenameString(<name>)/$$(p)Sets the name the Drone will be named to when the "rename" action is used.
$(#800)setRenameString(<name>)/$$(p)设置在使用“重命名”操作时要赋予雄蜂的名称。

$(#800)setRequiresTool(<true/false>)/$$(p)This configures whether or not the Drone requires a tool when executing the "dig" and "harvest" actions. With no tool, the Drone will not attempt to carry out these actions.
$(#800)setRequiresTool(<true/false>)/$$(p)此项用于配置雄蜂在执行“dig”和“harvest”动作时是否需要工具。没有工具时，雄蜂将不会尝试执行这些动作。

$(#800)setRightClickType("click_item" / "click_block")/$$(p)When the current action is "block_right_click", this controls whether the drone should use the click logic of its held item (e.g. use a $(item)Flint and Steel/$), or try to activate the targeted block (e.g. flip a $(item)Lever/$). The default is "click_item".
$(#800)setRightClickType("click_item" / "click_block")/$$(p)当当前动作是“block_right_click”时，此项用于控制无人机是使用其手持物品的点击逻辑（例如使用$(item)打火石/$），还是尝试激活目标方块（例如扳动$(item)拉杆/$）。默认值为“click_item”。

$(#800)setSide(<side>, <accessible>)/$$(p)Sets the specific side to be accessible or not. Used in the "inventory_import" and "inventory_export" actions to set which side of the inventory the Drone can access. It is also used for the "place" action to determine how to place the block.
$(#800)setSide(<side>, <accessible>)/$$(p)将指定的一侧设为可访问或不可访问。在“inventory_import”和“inventory_export”操作中使用，用于设置无人机可以访问容器的哪一侧。它也用于“place”操作，以确定如何放置方块。
$(#800)setSides(<down>, <up>, <north>, <south>, <east>, <west>)/$$(p)Same as above, but in a single method to set all sides at once; this method takes six boolean parameters.
$(#800)setSides(<down>, <up>, <north>, <south>, <east>, <west>)/$$(p)与上面相同，但这是一个可一次性设置所有面的单一方法；该方法接受六个布尔参数。
$(#800)setSignText(<line1>, <line2>, ..., <lineN>)/$$(p)Sets the text that will be sent to Signs and Aphorism Tiles when the $(thing)edit_sign/$ action is used.
$(#800)setSignText(<line1>, <line2>, ..., <lineN>)/$$(p)设置在使用$(thing)edit_sign/$操作时，将发送到告示牌和格言瓷砖的文本。
$(#800)setSneaking(<true/false>)/$$(p)Only used in the "block_right_click" action; this will set whether or not the fake player is sneaking while right clicking.
$(#800)setSneaking(<true/false>)/$$(p)仅用于“block_right_click”动作；这将设置假玩家在右击时是否处于潜行状态。
$(#800)setUseCount(<true/false>)/$$(p)Sets whether or not the Drone has a maximum number of imported /exported / dropped items. If true, be sure to also call $(#800)setCount()/$.
$(#800)setUseCount(<true/false>)/$$(p)设置雄蜂是否对导入/导出/丢弃的物品设定最大数量限制。若为 true，请务必同时调用$(#800)setCount()/$。

$(#800)setUseMaxActions(<true/false>)/$$(p)Sets whether or not the Drone has a maximum number of actions performed on one block at a time before the command is considered 'done'. Applies to the "place", "dig" and "block_right_click" actions. If true, be sure to also call $(#800)setMaxActions()/$.
$(#800)setUseMaxActions(<true/false>)/$$(p)设置雄蜂在同一时间对单个方块执行操作时，是否在执行达到最大次数后才将该命令视为“完成”。适用于“place”“dig”和“block_right_click”操作。如果为 true，请务必同时调用$(#800)setMaxActions()/$。

$(#800)setVariable(<variable name>, <x>, <y>, <z>)/$$(p)Sets a $(l:programming/variables)variable/$ for this Drone to given X/Y/Z coordinates. It is possible to set $(l:programming/variables#global)global variables/$.
$(#800)setVariable(<变量名称>, <x>, <y>, <z>)/$$(p)将此无人机的$(l:programming/variables)变量/$设置为给定的 X/Y/Z 坐标。也可以设置$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$。

$(#800)setVariable(<variable name>, <boolean>)/$$(p)Sets a $(l:programming/coordinate_operator)variable/$ for this Drone. 'true' is equivalent to passing (1,0,0), and 'false' is equivalent to passing (0,0,0).
$(#800)setVariable(<变量名>, <boolean>)/$$(p)为此无人机设置一个$(l:programming/coordinate_operator)变量/$。'true' 等同于传入 (1,0,0)，而 'false' 等同于传入 (0,0,0)。

$(#800)showArea()/$$(p)Will show the current stored area using the same area renderer used if you click $(thing)Show Area/$ in a programming widget options GUI. $(#800)hideArea()/$ can be used to hide any such areas.
$(#800)showArea()/$$(p)将使用与在程序部件选项 GUI 中点击$(thing)显示区域/$时相同的区域渲染器，来显示当前存储的区域。$(#800)hideArea()/$可用于隐藏任何此类区域。
